Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: standalone transparent photographic collage for a premium real-estate mortgage calculator card, independent concept A2. Not a website mockup and no text banner.
Primary request: create a deeply considered high-end advertising photomontage that connects a clear financial plan to a real future home. The ivory calculator is unmistakably the hero, with rich architectural and tactile supporting details arranged in a single coherent wide low scene.
Composition/framing: landscape 1.85:1. Main real physical ivory calculator dominates the front center, approximately 40 percent of total composition width. It is shown in a readable three-quarter view, not heavily rotated, with the top leaning slightly back and its face fully visible. Behind and to its right stands a detailed contemporary residential building fragment with authentic architectural scale, warm brick, white stone or plaster, finely proportioned windows, deep balconies with dark metal railings, subtle glazing reflections and a little natural greenery at its base and terraces. The building is real photographic architecture, NOT a toy house or plastic model. Its mass steps down naturally toward the edges.
Foreground details: on the left a large partly unfolded apartment floor-plan paper lies beside and partly behind the calculator, fine pale gray architectural drawing lines only, with a simple dark graphite pencil aligned diagonally on the paper. Paper layering, a lightly lifted corner and realistic thickness. On the front right a pair of realistic silver apartment keys on a circular keyring, detailed teeth and brushed metal, fully visible. All objects share the same implied ground plane, light direction and believable contact shadows.
Calculator accuracy: unbranded premium off-white desktop calculator, restrained matte plastic grain, graphite square rounded keys, one subtle sky-blue equals button. The LCD shows one small digit 0. Its main number grid MUST be exactly four rows: top row 7 8 9, second row 4 5 6, third row 1 2 3, bottom row 0 . =. A separate fourth column to the right of the number grid contains division, multiplication, minus, plus symbols from top to bottom. Do not repeat or rearrange digits. No decorative writing on the casing.
Brand geometry: behind the whole group, one large clean cyan transparent glass parallelogram / diamond plane offset left and one smaller smoky translucent graphite glass diamond plane toward the right. They evoke facets of a geometric real-estate logo without forming or copying a logo. Refined thin glass edges and restrained refraction. The geometry frames the subjects; it does not obscure the calculator or add floating clutter.
Lighting/mood: soft consistent upper-left daylight, calm and assured, premium editorial photography, nuanced contact shadows, no dramatic darkness or neon glow.
Materials: matte ivory calculator plastic, sharp graphite keys, paper fibers and folded edges, wooden graphite pencil, brushed and polished silver keys, subtle brick grain, white stone texture, window reflections and finely detailed leaves. Many small crafted details but a clear main silhouette.
Color palette: ivory and white, graphite #252C2F, warm natural brick, muted foliage, cyan #57C4ED used in glass and a calculator accent.
Background: genuine transparent alpha surrounding the isolated arrangement. Every object entirely inside the canvas with a small clean safety margin. No opaque floor, no haze, no background glow, no vignette, no gradient backdrop, no white or gray rectangle, no checkerboard. Contact shadows must fade completely into transparency. The cutout will be placed on a pale sage #EDF0E9 webpage surface.
Text: no words, no headline, no labels, no watermark, no logos, no percentages, no rates; only exact calculator digits and arithmetic key symbols described above.
Avoid: no people, no money, no coins, no toy-like building, no cartoon or illustration, no smooth generic CGI, no disconnected sticker collage, no cropped objects, no unreadable tiny calculator.
